scope: Resolve TaskGraph identity, acceptance, capabilities, and write bounds once for Team workers
changes: Added a typed ResolvedTaskContext carrying task/step/attempt/epoch identity, objective, acceptance, verification, references, required capabilities, and write paths.
RoleWorker now resolves that context once and uses it for attempt-bound output registration and prompt assembly.
The serialized host context is passed to AgentSubagentWorker and TrackedRoleWorker, which derive capability filtering, write-path intersections, leases, and request attribution from the typed value.
Existing prompts receive the host-resolved task contract; absent capabilities/paths remain distinct from explicit empty sets, and malformed task write-path values fail closed.
Added test source for context identity, missing-versus-empty scope, malformed paths, capability narrowing, and task injection into an existing prompt.
